19.2.intro: Build one clip from several sections, join them by touching, type exact In and Out times, and a new look for every icon.

highlights.title: Several sections in one clip
highlights.alt: The Clipr window with two locked sections on the timeline, the stretch between them folded away, new tool icons and a + section button next to Clip.
highlights.text: Press + section to lock the range you picked and start another. Each section shows on the timeline and in the footer with its own length, and Clip joins them into one clip. The audio lane now shows only the original, with no dub lanes.
highlights.caption: The real app with sample data.

highlights.title: Touch a section and they join
highlights.alt: A section dragged over another one, with a light outline around both, grips on the edges and the note Joins when you let go.
highlights.text: Drag a range with the Pointer and a small pill shows its exact start and end times. Drop it on another section, or draw or resize a range until it touches one, and a light outline shows the result: they join into one. The edges have grips with hover and press looks.
highlights.caption: Joins when you let go.

highlights.title: Type the start and end times
highlights.alt: The timeline and footer, with the In and Out times as two fields beside the clip length and the new tool icons above the timeline.
highlights.text: In and Out in the footer are now fields. Type or paste a time like 1:12:04 and the range moves to it. The tools above the timeline have new icons: the Pointer faces left, Range reads as a range, and Hand stays open.
highlights.caption: In and Out are fields.

cards.title: Campaigns in Settings
cards.alt: The Settings drawer listing the campaigns Acme and Nova with clips a day, each row ending in a chevron.
cards.text: Settings lists every campaign with its daily clips. Each row ends in a chevron that opens that campaign. The gear stays in the campaign menu in the top bar.
cards.caption: Sample data.

cards.title: Languages dropdown
cards.alt: A Languages dropdown open with Original ticked and Spanish unticked.
cards.text: Languages is a dropdown with tick boxes, shown only when the video has dubs. The separate Clips folder row is gone, since each campaign has its own folder.
cards.caption: Sample data.

changes.title: Merge on touch
changes.text: A range you draw, resize or drop on another section joins it into one.

changes.title: Time pill
changes.text: While you move a range, a small pill over it shows its start and end times.

changes.title: One Final Cut project
changes.text: Each clip gets one Final Cut project with all its languages inside.

changes.title: Twitch and Kick
changes.text: Paste a Twitch or Kick video or clip link and cut it like a YouTube one. These have no transcript.

changes.title: Preview
changes.text: Preview plays only the range you picked, not the whole video.

changes.title: Zoom
changes.text: Zooming out starts from the left edge of the timeline, never the middle.

changes.title: Handles
changes.text: Range handles light up when you hover them and change when you press.

changes.title: No dub lanes
changes.text: The timeline shows one audio lane instead of a lane for every dub.

changes.title: Icons
changes.text: All icons are now Bootstrap Icons, with new tool icons above the timeline.

changes.title: Updates
changes.text: Restart to update waits for a clip being made, and you can cancel the wait.

changes.title: Pasted links
changes.text: A pasted link opens in the background, and a failed open says why.

changes.title: DaVinci Resolve
changes.text: Resolve now gets the same timeline file as Final Cut.

changes.title: Premiere Pro
changes.text: Premiere Pro shows as Coming soon in the Clip menu and can't be picked yet.

changes.title: Slow start
changes.text: A slow first run of a tool now says it is still checking, not that it failed.

changes.title: Folders
changes.text: Clipr checks that your chosen folders can be written to and says so if not.

19.1.0.intro: Paste a link right in the top bar, three-dot menus on every row, and a lot of timeline polish.

highlights.title: Paste a link in the top bar
highlights.alt: The Clipr window with a YouTube link typed into the field in the middle of the top bar.
highlights.text: The middle of the top bar is now a link field. Click it, paste a link and press Enter: the video opens and is added to your list. Esc puts the title back.
highlights.caption: The real app with sample data.

highlights.title: Three-dot menus on every row
highlights.alt: A video row's menu open, showing Mark done, Open on YouTube and Remove video.
highlights.text: Each video row has a ⋯ button that is always there. It holds Mark done, Open on YouTube and Remove video. Videos search is now only for searching your own list.
highlights.caption: Sample data.

highlights.title: Sign-in moves to Settings
highlights.alt: The Sign in for 1080p page inside the Settings drawer, with three short steps.
highlights.text: Sign in for 1080p now lives in Settings, behind a gear icon, along with each campaign's export settings.
highlights.caption: Settings, Sign in for 1080p.

cards.title: Timeline
cards.alt: The timeline with a selected range and the clip's name on its bar.
cards.text: Audio lanes can be turned on and off, and a line on the range bar shows where a clip gets too long. Space plays or pauses from anywhere, and joined clips skip the gaps.
cards.caption: Sample data.

cards.title: Export and History rows
cards.alt: Export list rows, each with a three-dot button on the right.
cards.text: The same always-there ⋯ menu is on every Export and History row.
cards.caption: Sample data.

changes.title: Walkthrough
changes.text: Tips dim everything except the control they point at.

changes.title: 5 seconds either side
changes.text: Clipr always adds 5 seconds at both ends of a clip, so the Extra seconds choice is gone.

changes.title: Transcripts
changes.text: Language matching is wider, and a failed fetch now says so instead of staying empty.

changes.title: Timeline room
changes.text: There is extra room at the end, and you can zoom out to a third of the lane.

changes.title: Settings
changes.text: The campaign folder picks the campaign you are editing, and Clips folder Change is inline.

changes.title: Editor files
changes.text: Files for your editor keep the clip's name and never overwrite an earlier file.

changes.title: Interrupted cuts
changes.text: An interrupted cut's range comes back, and Stop works while the download is starting.

changes.title: Ctrl+Enter
changes.text: The walkthrough card no longer blocks Ctrl+Enter.

changes.title: Logo glow
changes.text: The glow behind the logo on the start screen is no longer cropped.

changes.title: Final Cut
changes.text: Saved frame rates follow the video, and an older look gets its size when chosen again.

19.0.0.intro: A quiet download-progress pill for updates, safer end points, and a round of timeline polish.

highlights.title: Update progress
highlights.alt: The Clipr window with a quiet Downloading update 42% pill in the top bar.
highlights.text: While an update downloads, a small pill in the top bar shows how far along it is. Nothing to click and nothing in the way.
highlights.caption: The real app with sample data. The pill sits beside the layout and help buttons.

highlights.title: Clips that run past the end
highlights.alt: An Export row reading Ran past the end; stops at 1:13:10.
highlights.text: If an out point lands beyond the end of the video, the clip stops at the end and its row says so in one dim line. An in point past the end is refused.
highlights.caption: The line under the clip's times.

highlights.title: Start fresh
highlights.alt: The Clipr has changed a lot dialog with Start fresh and Keep my data buttons.
highlights.text: No folders are made in Downloads until a clip is saved, and the prompt asks only once per session.
highlights.caption: Your campaigns, bank and history go into a backup first.

changes.title: Sign-in
changes.text: A rejected sign-in now shows in its own row, and private videos are told apart from members-only ones.

changes.title: Offline
changes.text: After repeated offline failures, Copy details is offered so you can send a report.

changes.title: Updating
changes.text: Restart to update waits until the clip you are making is done.

changes.title: Clip count and length
changes.text: Each clip made with the Clip button counts once, and a clip longer than 24 hours is refused.

cards.title: Timeline
cards.alt: The timeline with a range selected and the clip name on its bar.
cards.text: Zoom keeps its centre and follows the pointer. Both ends of a range move together, and clip names show on the bars.
cards.caption: Sample data.

cards.title: Window strip
cards.alt: The Clipr start screen with a link field and a Paste button.
cards.text: The start and crash screens can be dragged by a strip along the top edge.
cards.caption: The start screen.

18.0.0.intro: Clearer clip failures, a space check before each clip, and Final Cut timelines that follow your look.

highlights.title: Checks before it fails
highlights.text: Clipr checks the folder has room and can be written to before a clip starts, and says plainly if it can't.

highlights.title: Timeline size for Final Cut
highlights.text: Pick vertical 9:16, same as the video, or from your look, under Your look in Settings.

highlights.title: Copy your clip list
highlights.text: Copy as text or save a .txt from the Export and History menus.

changes.title: Clip length per campaign
changes.text: An optional row in campaign settings, with a plain verdict in the export bar.

changes.title: Audio lane per language
changes.text: Each ticked audio language gets its own lane, and YouTube's control bar is hidden in the preview.

changes.title: Start fresh
changes.text: After updating from an older version, a one-time prompt offers a fresh start. Your data is backed up first.

changes.title: Failure rows
changes.text: Rows now say when a folder can't be written, a drive is missing, or a video is age-restricted or members-only.

changes.title: After a crash
changes.text: A note says so, with a dismiss button, and clears when the next clip finishes.

changes.title: Send report
changes.text: Reports go through the live report service, and the page confirms what was sent.

changes.title: Waiting for the transcript
changes.text: The transcript lane and tab show a quiet waiting state instead of looking empty.

changes.title: Timeline
changes.text: A rounded timeline card with the tools row on top and the export bar fixed at the bottom.

changes.title: Frame rate
changes.text: Changing the timeline kind no longer resets the frame rate to 30.

changes.title: Fit
changes.text: Fit keeps the ruler centred.

17.0.0.intro: Timeline fixes, and no empty folder made at launch.

changes.title: Short timelines
changes.text: A short timeline scrolls its tracks under a sticky ruler.

changes.title: Cleaner launch
changes.text: Clipr no longer creates its data folder until it has something to save.

changes.title: Select range key
changes.text: Select range is now D, keeping S free for skipping in review.

16.0.0.intro: A title bar that doubles as the top bar, new timeline tools, and a clear reason for every failure.

highlights.title: Timeline tools
highlights.text: Select range, zoom and pinch, a pointer that scrubs, and scissors that drag a range.

highlights.title: Top bar is the title bar
highlights.text: On Mac and Windows the top bar now doubles as the window's title bar.

highlights.title: Failures say why
highlights.text: Removed video, bot check, rate limit, format gone and missing tools each get their own sentence.

changes.title: Undo for the Clip button
changes.text: Undo now restores a moment made with the Clip button, and each clip keeps its own row name.

changes.title: Crash fallback page
changes.text: A second crash within a minute shows a simple page with Reopen, Send report and Copy details.

changes.title: Retry keeps your range
changes.text: A failed cut keeps its range. Retry re-cuts it, and Save for later banks it.

changes.title: Final Cut
changes.text: A picked look always applies, and an unreadable old look no longer blocks the move.

changes.title: Settings safety
changes.text: If the settings file is gone or empty, Clipr restores the kept copy and says so.

changes.title: Help and tips
changes.text: Tips on or off is shared by every video, and Help search covers transcript, speed, quota and zoom.

changes.title: Zoom cap
changes.text: View menu Zoom In now obeys the zoom cap.

changes.title: Left panels
changes.text: Back returns to the video you were on, and failed links are not saved.

15.0.0.intro: Clearer help, Final Cut layouts, and failures that tell you why.

highlights.title: Help that walks you through it
highlights.text: Answers come as numbered steps, and Show me in Clipr points at the real buttons.

highlights.title: Final Cut layouts
highlights.text: Choose how each campaign lands in Final Cut: one Export event, an event per video, per day, or flat.

highlights.title: Clear failures
highlights.text: A failed clip says why, with Retry and Change folder on the same row.

changes.title: Open in your editor
changes.text: Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve and CapCut open with the saved clip from the Clip menu.

changes.title: Import moments
changes.text: Add several moments at once from a list or a sheet.

changes.title: First-use tips
changes.text: Short pointers on first use, which you can replay from Help.

changes.title: Sign-in at launch
changes.text: Clipr checks your YouTube sign-in when it opens, so 1080p is ready when you are.

changes.title: Clip names
changes.text: Names come from the words in the range, and the name is the file's name.

changes.title: Undo
changes.text: Undo takes back every language of a clip you just made.

changes.title: Space on buttons
changes.text: Space now presses the button you are on.

changes.title: Speed control
changes.text: Speed no longer sits over Back 5.

changes.title: Two-word clip names
changes.text: Clip names are two words, and the name is checked before a project name is suggested.
